methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: A multi-stakeholder initiative to evaluate AI deployment across the Roanoke Valley signals intentional capacity-building outside traditional tech hubs, potentially advancing distributed adoption if it moves beyond assessment to implementation and skills development.

signals.title: SWVA leaders discuss AI in classrooms at symposium - WJHL
signals.signal_reading: Regional leaders convening to discuss classroom AI integration in Southwest Virginia demonstrates distributed agency and peer learning networks forming outside metro centers, though depth depends on whether discussions translate to genuine pedagogical transformation versus surface-level tool adoption.

signals.title: Sentara hospitals are using AI to help monitor patients, determine discharge timelines
signals.signal_reading: Sentara's deployment of AI for patient monitoring and discharge planning concentrates advanced healthcare AI capability within an existing institutional hub, creating deep technical capacity that may not readily diffuse to smaller healthcare providers across rural Virginia.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon scrapping four NoVA data center plans due to backlash signals that even concentrated infrastructure development faces resistance, potentially stalling both the physical layer needed for distributed AI access and the local economic multiplier effects that could fund broader digital equity initiatives.

signals.title: CAREER CORNER: Greater Roanoke workforce board joins five-board Appalachian Advancement initiative - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: A five-board Appalachian workforce initiative spanning multiple regions demonstrates distributed coalition-building for economic advancement, creating potential peer networks for AI skills development if technology adoption becomes an explicit focus of cross-regional collaboration.
